quote.translation: The causal series M M′ M″, which includes M, and the causal series N N′ N″, which includes N, can in turn be thought to have a further common cause, T. Yet T too means the point of intersection of one causal series with another, and there is room for chance there as well, whilst the two series can again be thought to have a common cause.
